description: Set the shared board name shown to every collaborator (rail label, tab title, export filenames). Works in draw and todo mode. Whitespace is collapsed; max 100 chars. Pass `name: null` or "" to clear (clients then show the board id). Read it as `name` from `get_board` / `list_tasks`.

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.

name.description: New board name; null or empty clears it.

name: rename_board
title: Rename Board
